svg.text: 1 · Infrastructure: WideWorldImporters → Snowflake with dbt, orchestrated by Airflow
Everything except Snowflake runs on one Ubuntu VM deployed in AWS, in Docker containers.
AWS · EC2 virtual machine · Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
read over ODBC by the worker
dbt snapshot · dbt run · dbt test
inbound: 22 (SSH) and 8080 (Airflow UI) from my IP only
outbound: 443 (HTTPS) to Snowflake; Snowflake never connects in
secrets: key-pair auth for SVC_AIRFLOW; no passwords in DAGs or git
conformed dimensions reused by the mart
fact_sales_line · one row per invoice line
